messages.subject: Houlihan Lokey | 2025 Summer Analyst Program | Availability Request
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Thank you for your interest in Houlihan Lokey's 2025 Summer Financial Analyst - Corporate Finance Consumer, Food & Retail position in LA!

We would like to schedule a 1st round interview with a banker from the Consumer, Food & Retail team. The interview format will be a 30-minute video interview via Zoom.

Please reply to this email with a few days/times that work well for you the week of 2/5 and 2/12, including your respective time zone. We will schedule accordingly and be in touch to confirm your interview in the coming days.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best,
Sara Laracca, Recruiting Analyst
